title: Code of Virginia, Title 38.2 (Insurance), Chapter 5 - Unfair Trade Practices
verified_how: fetched https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title38.2/chapter5/ (HTTP 200): heading 'Chapter 5. Unfair Trade Practices', listing s 38.2-500 (Declaration of purpose), 38.2-501 (Definitions), 38.2-502 (Misrepresentations and false advertising of insurance policies), 38.2-503, 38.2-504 (Defamation), 38.2-505 (Boycott, coercion and intimidation), 38.2-506, 38.2-507, 38.2-508 (Unfair discrimination), 38.2-508.1, 38.2-508.2 and 38.2-508.3 onward, none marked 'Repealed' or '(Effective ...)'. I also fetched the title index https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacode/title38.2/ (HTTP 200): 'Chapter 5 Unfair Trade Practices [ss 38.2-500 through 38.2-518]'. Currency: the register's own 2026 Updates page (https://law.lis.virginia.gov/vacodeupdates/) states 'this is a list of updated sections that took effect on July 1, 2026, unless otherwise noted', so the online Code reflects the 2026 session. The site marks future text as '(Effective <date>)' and dead text as 'Repealed', and the cited provisions carry neither marker. Note that article-level URLs such as /vacode/title40.1/chapter3/article2/ return HTTP 200 with an EMPTY content pane, so the citable register page for an article is its chapter page, which prints the article heading and its section list.
notes: Unfair claim settlement practices sit within this chapter (Va. Code s 38.2-510). General policy-content and claim-payment rules are in Title 38.2 ch. 3 (Provisions Relating to Insurance Policies and Contracts) and, for health carriers, ch. 35.1 (Health Carrier Internal Appeal Process and External Review), both seen on the same title index. Detailed claim-handling standards are Bureau of Insurance regulation rather than statute.
